integrity.imported_premise: The Betti vector (1,5,15,20,15,5,1) and odd-cohomology vanishing are imported from the source Tate-type cohomology computation.
integrity.new_proof_component: Finite-field irreducibility of the reduced Poincare polynomial and the Kunneth-product obstruction are proved independently in the package.

scientific_limitations: The conclusion is a rational-cohomological obstruction to nontrivial products of positive-dimensional connected smooth proper complex Deligne--Mumford stacks or varieties.
It does not address birational, fibrational, derived, or motivic decompositions.
The argument uses the exact Tate-type Betti numbers computed in arXiv:2610.01829v1.
title: The one-pointed genus-two compactified universal Jacobian is rationally product-indecomposable
